visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair wearing a grey t-shirt faces the camera in a bright indoor room. She holds two sealed purple Chiikawa Weiss Schwarz card boxes, smiling widely with a playful expression while gesturing towards the products. (2) A domestic tabby and white cat enters the frame from the left, sniffing the card boxes held by the woman. The woman reacts by leaning towards the cat, maintaining a joyful and engaged facial expression in a well-lit home studio environment. (3) The woman begins unboxing the cards, showing the inner foil packs to the camera. She carefully uses her hands to manipulate the packaging, displaying the individual packs which feature various colorful Chiikawa characters against a blue and white background. (4) A rapid sequence of shots follows, each focusing on a different Chiikawa trading card held close to the lens. The cards feature various characters like Usagi, Hachiware, and Chiikawa in different poses; some have a holographic, sparkly finish known as RR rarity. (5) The woman displays a collection of pulled cards, fanning them out to show the variety. She continues to smile and look directly into the lens, showing her excitement about the results of the unboxing in the same consistent indoor setting.
